store.summary: Shut down the CardputerZero safely before using the power switch.
store.description:
Flipping the power switch while Linux is running can corrupt the SD card. Power Off shuts the CardputerZero down cleanly first.

Open it, press 4 (or Enter) to power off, then flip the switch once all the lights are off. Press 8 or hold ESC to go back without shutting down.

No password needed: it asks the system for a normal shutdown, the same as choosing Shut Down on a desktop.
